name: @pratibimba/bases-view
description: M-stack BasesView Theia extension (Track 48 §13.D): the C5/CS reflection surface over the coordinate-keyed Bimba index. A ReactWidget + AbstractViewContribution injecting SHARED_BRIDGE_ADAPTER, a pure basesModelFromRecords render service with table/cards/list/image view modes, and a BasesDataSource with static (s1'.vault.read_file snapshot) and dynamic (s2 live query) adapters. Pure read — no canon writes, no S-stack import.
